I am an old woman of 87 years here in Iringa. My strength is not what it was, so I depend on my children and grandchildren to help me work this small maize plot near the house. I have no money for chemical fertilizer or hybrid seeds from the shop — I save my own seed from last year's harvest like I have always done, and I put the manure from our few animals on the soil. The rains here in the highlands are usually enough for maize, so I do not irrigate, and I cannot afford sprays.
